coverage.content: Abstract and Sections 1-2: fully submodular flow setting, feasibility theorem and prior methods.
m-flow equivalence; level invariants, tight sets and stopping rules.
Stopping certificate proof and arc/node/lift operations.
Lowest-level queue traversal and algorithm pseudocode.
Conclusion and ten references; reference 9 is TR13-01.
coverage.question_screen: Two linked future directions: avoid smallest tight sets, and seek a simpler O(n^2*m) feasibility method, at least on special networks.

explicit_future_directions.paraphrase: Avoid explicitly determining smallest tight sets in a future algorithm.
Develop a simpler O(n^2*m) feasible-submodular-flow algorithm, at least for some network classes.

reading_method: All 7 pages read through complete web extraction and local text; rendered PDF pages 3,5,7 independently inspected. Not a keyword-only screen.
title: A simple push-relabel algorithm for sub-modular flows
